recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-8839; future work should not re-add the old code/label prohibition unless FHIR-I reverses FHIR-48326.
issue_request: FHIR-8839 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction against FHIR-core StructureDefinition. It reported that the ElementDefinition interpretation table said requirements were optional on the first ElementDefinition while sdf-9 forbade requirements there, and the approved resolution was to fix the table typo.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 7142, imported as git commit c38c9a8edcb9e41f02d9b5b49aa2ffa25f924251, which changed source/elementdefinition.html so the relevant first-element table cells were prohibited instead of optional.
additional_context: Related later sdf-9 issues FHIR-13721 and FHIR-15803 corrected the expression and grammar and are already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-48326 later intentionally removed code and label from sdf-9 while retaining requirements because ElementDefinition.requirements overlaps StructureDefinition.purpose.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change is needed because source/elementdefinition.html now marks requirements as prohibited for type-definition and constraint-definition root elements, and source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml contains a requirements-only sdf-9 invariant matching that table.
